scenarios.invariant: Conflicting applicable duties cannot authorize a maker action without qualified human approval.
Every host receives the same pinned semantics, tool declarations, governance controls, and conformance vectors.
A completed erasure is evidenced and the same subject data cannot silently re-enter the graph.
Only the exact certified action executes once and its observed effect discharges the matching obligation.
Unpermitted personal data never crosses the connector boundary and the denial remains auditable.
A policy or graph change invalidates an earlier admission before execution.
Mandate drift, material proxy loss, or failed falsifiability trips quarantine before another effect.
An observed unpermitted effect cannot be represented as certified success and requires reconciliation.
